JPEG codec — references/image/src/codecs/jpeg/ + zune-jpeg/jpeg-encoder Pure Nim baseline DCT: SOI/APP/DQT/SOF0+SOF1(8-bit)/DHT/DRI/SOS/RST/EOI, Huffman, separable float IDCT, 4:4:4/4:2:2/4:2:0 (+general H/V replication), YCbCr/RGB/gray/CMYK-Adobe. Progressive (SOF2) spectra + refinements.

Types

JpegScratch = object
  clean*: PooledBuffer[uint8] ## Assembly row buffers (Y/Cb/Cr gather rows, `outW` bytes each) for
                              ## the 3-component fast path. Same terms as `clean`: largest width
                              ## wins, capacity retained across decodes. Fully overwritten per row,
                              ## so no zeroing is needed (unlike PNG `prev`, which filters row 0
                              ## against zeros). Width-sized KBs: `shrinkAfterSpike` leaves them
                              ## alone. The exotic-sampling `xmaps` (3x `outW` ints, almost never
                              ## taken) stay fresh allocs — pooling them would pin capacity for a
                              ## path that barely runs.
  yRow*: PooledBuffer[uint8]
  cbRow*: PooledBuffer[uint8]
  crRow*: PooledBuffer[uint8]
Reusable cross-decode scratch for decodeJpeg. Owns the cleaned entropy buffer across calls, so decoding many similar-size photos (a gallery walk) allocates the largest scan buffer once instead of once per photo. Outputs are unaffected: every scan rebuilds the content from clear(). Not thread-safe — use one per decoding thread. Call shrinkAfterSpike after a large photo if the process keeps decoding much smaller ones, so peak capacity is not pinned.

proc decodeJpeg(data: openArray[uint8]; denom = 1): ImageResult[DynamicImage] {.
    ...raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Baseline / progressive JPEG decode. denom 2/4/8 emits a 1/denom-scaled image (full IDCT + in-block box average, libjpeg -scale style); 1 is full resolution. Output dims are ceil(w/denom). 
proc decodeJpeg(data: openArray[uint8]; scratch: var JpegScratch; denom = 1): ImageResult[
    DynamicImage] {....raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Baseline / progressive JPEG decode reusing scratch across calls. Bit-identical to decodeJpeg(data, denom); only the cleaned entropy buffer and the assembly rows are retained between decodes (not pixels, not coefficients). Pass a long-lived scratch when decoding many photos in a row; call shrinkAfterSpike to release a past entropy peak. 
proc decodeJpegRgbaInto(data: openArray[uint8]; scratch: var JpegScratch;
                        dst: ptr UncheckedArray[Rgba[uint8]]; capPx: int;
                        denom = 1): ImageResult[tuple[w, h: int]] {....raises: [],
    tags: [], forbids: [].}
Decode baseline/progressive JPEG straight into a caller-owned RGBA buffer: no Rgb temp, no conversion alloc. Bit-identical to decodeJpeg(data, scratch, denom) + toRgba8 for gray and 3-component input; 4-component (CMYK/YCCK) returns Unsupported (fall back to the conversion path). capPx must cover ceil(w/denom)*ceil(h/denom) pixels; a short (or nil) destination fails cleanly with dst untouched.
